overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long GLXY Daily Target ETF (GLXU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Galaxy Digital Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: GLXY), less fees and expenses, through derivatives such as swap agreements. GLXU was launched on Aug 8, 2025 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
